meta.parties: Wanigaratne Et Al. v. Selohamy Et Al

rules.statement: A deed of gift to a concubine is not necessarily invalid under Roman-Dutch law, and the revocation of such a gift must be supported by evidence that it was made for immoral consideration.
rules.supporting_quote: "The principle adopted by the Cape Supreme Court is that it will not lend its power and authority to the enforcement of contracts made for illegal or immoral consideration. Hence a concubine or prostitute would not be able to sue for anything promised her in consideration of illicit intercourse."
